sch: Bulk historical stat import (analyst: Jim Totime), source: Standard_Stats_Segunda_RFEF_Group_3_2026_2027.xlsx, one workbook, one club sheet per team (17 clubs), direct. This is a single Standard Stats file only -- unlike the JPL batches, there was no separate Shooting/Playing Time/Miscellaneous/GK workbook for this league, so no t1 shot/foul/tackle breakdown exists for these rows. The source has no nationality or birth-year column at all -- nat left null and pid uses this DB's 'unknown-unk-unkN' convention (name known, identity data not) rather than guessing at nationality from playing in a Spanish regional league. The source also has no assists column anywhere -- a left null for every player, not assumed 0. Age is given directly (not birth year); some cells append a 'Sub-23' tag to the age with no separator (e.g. '22Sub-23') marking the club's U23-quota squad list -- parsed out, age stored as the clean integer, and sub23:true added only where that tag was present. Two source quirks specific to this workbook: (1) three of the seventeen club sheets have a swapped column order (position before full name instead of after) and were parsed against their own header row rather than a fixed column index; (2) goalkeepers' 'Goles' column is parenthesized (e.g. '(2)') and is goals CONCEDED, not scored -- extracted separately as gaGK, with g left null for keepers rather than misrepresenting goals-against as goals-scored. 13 players across 8 clubs sit under a 'Sin Determinar' (position undetermined) section in the source itself, not a parsing gap -- pos left null for those, all have '-' for age and 0 or near-0 minutes, consistent with unassigned trialists. shortName (common/nickname form) and demarcacion (the original detailed Spanish position label, e.g. 'Lateral Izquierdo') are carried as extra fields alongside the FW/MF/DF/GK bucket used for pos. callUps (PC, matchday squad call-ups) and starts (PT) are included as extra fields; PJ (matches played) and Min map to mp/min as usual. The workbook also contains an unrelated 'premier-league-matches' sheet (12,000+ rows of 1993-2023 English Premier League results) -- not used, has nothing to do with this league.
